item.title: feat(browser,tls): viewport clipping, HTTP/meta redirects, remote PNG/BMP rendering & Poly1305 carry fix
item.description:
- Viewport & layout manager (apps/ola-mundo/src/font.rs, apps/ola-mundo/src/browser.rs): - Added draw_char_clipped_rect / draw_text_clipped_rect with horizontal+vertical scissor bounds. - Added content_clip_bottom(h) so text, boxes,
, , and the vertical scrollbar stop strictly above the 14px BRCR status bar; compacted BRCR label when narrow (<460px). - Clipped and panned address-bar URL strictly before the TLS1.3/e1000 status badge; clamped Flexbox row children and raised MAX_RENDER_LINES to 512. - Redirects & URL resolution (apps/ola-mundo/src/browser.rs, apps/ola-mundo/src/main.rs): - Followed HTTP 301/302/303/307/308 Location headers and redirects, updating active_url across UI, relative links, history, and cache. - Prevented is_web_domain from classifying image/asset extensions (.png/.jpg/.bmp/.css/.js/etc.) as domains. - Remote fetching & #![no_std] PNG decoding (apps/ola-mundo/src/browser.rs, apps/ola-mundo/src/main.rs): - Added .bss REMOTE_IMG_CACHE (8x64KiB), prefetch_page_images (up to 6 unique images/page), pure #![no_std] PNG decoder (IHDR/PLTE/tRNS/IDAT via deflate, color types 0/2/3/4/6, filters 0..4), aspect-ratio auto-sizing, and scroll-offset cropping. - TLS 1.3 Poly1305 carry fix (apps/ola-mundo/src/tls.rs, src/net/tls13.rs): - Propagated carry from h1 >> 44 into h2 before final modulo-2^130-5 reduction and replaced bitwise-OR limb packing with wrapping_add so carries into bit 44/88 cannot fail AEAD on >35 KiB streams (verified against https://jinn-os.dev.br 54,762 B). item.title: docs(web,net): publish TLS 1.3 post-mortem, fallback HTTP and telemetry to GitHub & Google News [announce]
item.description: Problemas identificados (PCAP QEMU + Jinn Browser): - Poly1305 RFC 8439 (src/net/tls13.rs, apps/ola-mundo/src/tls.rs): mistura de mascaras 60/50 bits com deslocamentos incompativeis no acumulador 44/44/42 bits reprovava registros handshake cifrados em servidores reais (jinn-os.dev.br). - Ausencia de TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 (0x1301) e falta de reassembly multi-record para cadeias Certificate (~3.4-4.1 KiB em 4 registros). - decrypt_application_data retornava None para alertas cifrados CONTENT_ALERT (21, ex. close_notify 24B em 68k.news), descartando respostas HTTP validas ja decifradas. - HTTP_BUF_SIZE (64 KiB) e MAX_DOM_NODES (256) saturavam paginas reais >50 KiB; resolve_target_path enviava dominios sem esquema direto para HTTP. - parse_html_into_dom descartava texto apos tags de fechamento inline (, ) e a tela de erro exibia rotulos estaticos em branco. Modificacoes e resolucoes: - Corrigida aritmetica 44/44/42 bits do Poly1305 (kernel + browser) e implementado Aes128Gcm completo em .bss/#[no_std]. - Adicionado reassembly TLS multi-record (HS_REASM_BUF 32 KiB, HS_DECRYPT_BUF 18 KiB), AppRecord::Alert para close_notify e HTTP_BUF_SIZE=128 KiB / MAX_DOM_NODES=512. - Implementado resolve_target_with_mode + fallback automatico https:// -> http:// em browser_load_and_display apenas para alvos sem esquema explicito. - Captura de texto pos-fechamento em DomNodeType::Text com coalescencia inline e telemetria real (FetchDiagInfo + Syscalls 88 e 97). - Publicado artigo Google News/NewsArticle em web/artigos/ e regenerados web/artigos/index.html, web/feed.xml, web/rss.xml e web/sitemap.xml. ---END--- [Ganho técnico: Indicadores citados no relatório: 4.1 KiB, 24B, 64 KiB, 50 KiB] [Ecossistemas & Menções: Google, Cloudflare, Sovereign Public Infrastructure, STMicroelectronics, RISC-V International, Academic Systems Research Labs, Akamai, Huawei] [Palavras-chave: Jinn OS, Microkernel, Rust no_std, x86_64, post-mortems, security-lab, Microkernel Architecture, TLS 1.3 Cryptography, W^X Memory Enforcement, L2/L3 Fast-Path Networking] [Evidências visuais: docs(web,net): publish TLS 1.3 post-mortem, fallback HTTP and telemetry to GitHub & Google News [announce] (https://jinn-os.dev.br/assets/wallpaper.jpg)] [Aplicabilidade: Indústria, Uso Doméstico e Servidores | Chamada Aberta para Pilotos: https://jinn-os.dev.br/#win-contact | https://github.com/GeovaneEstanislau/Jinn_Project]
